title: Crop Guard
summary: Checks a crop against faces, headlines and platform overlays, so a profile photo or Story doesn't cut off a face or hide text under the UI.
description: Checks pluggable face and text boxes against the crop, the profile circle and Story safe zones, offers a one-tap fit that moves the crop as little as possible, and previews it at the small size people actually see.
catches: Faces or text boxes cut by the crop edge
Content hidden by a circle mask or a platform's Story UI
Subjects too small to recognise at thumbnail size
A nearest fit that keeps everything in, moving the crop as little as possible
limits: Needs face and text boxes from you or a detect function; it has no built-in detector
Safe zones are presets and may not match a platform's latest layout
Sometimes no crop can fit everything; it says so
a11y: The crop area is keyboard-operable: arrow keys move it, + and - resize
Shape presets are a role="radiogroup" with arrow-key navigation
The image takes alt text; problems are described in text
